text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking down the hallway with
Satono
Diamond, when...
Theeere you aaaaare!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Satono! As of today, I appoint thee
"Magical
Dia"!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? Magical Dia?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It is I, Magical Black, member of Magical
Girl ☆
Sweepy 5!
Or something like
that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're doing this too, Kita?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Get this! Sweep created a team
called
Magical Girl ☆ Sweepy 5.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And she appointed me "Magical Black"
not too
long ago!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So I thought it would be great if you
joined in
too... What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Our current roster consists of Magical
Black,
Professor Tachyon, and me,
Genius Magical Girl
Sweepy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow, and you all practice magic
together? That
sounds fun. ♪ I'd love to
join!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You mean it?! Excellent! ♪ Then let's
dive straight
into your magical training!
Um...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That one! Defeat that individual
standing
there!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You never know when or where an
enemy will
appear. Practice is important!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But... What exactly should I do to defeat
my
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you all you need to know. ♪
Ready?
First chant a spell like this...
choice_data_list: (She's already working on the premise that she'll be defeated...?)

text_block_list.text:
...Heh, heh, heh. Magic isn't the only
method to
vanquishing one's foes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You also have the option of
strengthening
yourself via a chemical
concoction. I can certainly
assist you
should you choose that route.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's still my time in the spotlight!

You'd rather have me teach you than
Tachyon,
right, Satono?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Both of your methods sound
fun. ♪
Oh! Who do you think I should go
with, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heh! The natural choice! Now then,
let me
show you the proper way to cast
a spell. ♪ Watch
closely!
choice_data_list: Let's have Sweep Tosho teach us.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Panthus, panthus, agapanthus! Rain
down, O
starlight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing happens. However, as one
would
expect of a self-proclaimed
magical girl, her
execution certainly
feels on point somehow.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Did you follow that? All you need
to do is
chant a spell that fits who you
are. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I think I understand. A spell that fits
me...
Okay, I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I know you can do it, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Behold! The dazzling glimmer of a
diamond! The
radiant beacon of
tranquility!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I truly see a dazzling light before me. Or
at least I
get the sense I do, and
collapse to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You were really sparkling! You're
amazing,
Satono! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Magical Dia! I officially approve your
induction
into Magical Girl ☆ Sweepy 5!
You know what
this means, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I, Magical Dia, will continue
to shine
ever brighter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand much about
magic, but
watching them have fun
together seems to have
the power to
bring a smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heh. An excellent choice!
Now
then, Satono, guzzle this potion down to

strengthen your body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon takes out a strangely
colored
concoction. ...Something about
all this feels
worrying.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's a really weird color... You sure
you wanna
drink that, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What? That's no fun. Are you really
going to
chicken out?
choice_data_list: Let's call it off after all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I never go back on my
decisions. Even
if it means going against
my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes the potion from Agnes
Tachyon and
downs it all in one gulp!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow. I've never tasted anything quite
like that
before! How curious!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho! I added extra capsaicin to increase
blood
flow, and you polished it off like
it was nothing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... You're quite the
intriguing
specimen! Okay, now I want
you to go for a run!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-way to go, Magical Dia! You're now
an official
member of Magical Girl ☆
Sweepy 5! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious about the capsaicin she
ingested, I
approach Satono Diamond
after Sweep Tosho
and the others leave.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...So you noticed?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It honestly felt like my tongue was
on fire.
But I couldn't exactly let
everyone see me
grimace. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She quietly reveals the truth. I'm pleased
to see
her doing something so typical for
her age as
putting on a brave face for
her friends.
